name: Granblue Fantasy
description:
About This Game

Granblue Fantasy is a classic JRPG that first launched in Japan for mobile devices and web browsers in 2014. Now, for the first time, new players outside of Japan can join the experience through Steam!

Note: Existing Granblue Fantasy accounts can’t be linked to a Steam account.

Into the Blue. And Beyond.

Take up the role of a skyfarer and embark on a journey across the Sky Realm and the innumerable islands dotting its vast blue expanse. 

Inside, you’ll find a deep, turn-based combat system packed with nuanced mechanics, elemental strategies, and an enormous array of skills to pull from. Cinematic charge attacks, team-based chain bursts, and towering summons elevate your battles with both devastating effectiveness and dazzling visuals. Whether tackling raids solo or joining fellow skyfarers in real-time co-op raids, there’s always a new challenge to conquer. With more than 70 distinctive classes and robust character and weapon progression, there’s a wealth of content to explore and optimize—perfect for dedicated adventurers. 

Fate-Woven Stories

Beyond the main quest lies myriad tales—sometimes heartfelt, sometimes lighthearted, but always rich in character. Each encounter is brought to life with full voice acting, and every new crewmate brings their own story, with fate episodes that delve deeper into their lore. Discover your favorites, strengthen your crew, and forge parties to surmount any challenge. In these boundless skies, Granblue Fantasy offers countless ways to play, and countless reasons to fall in love with the journey.
short_desc: Set forth on a grand journey across boundless skies in this landmark RPG, featuring fully voiced characters brought to life by the iconic artistry of Hideo Minaba and music scored by legendary composer Nobuo Uematsu.
